scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:render
scripts.tauri:bundle: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.grok.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.local.macos.conf.json -- --features impersonate-boring
scripts.build:windows:cross: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs tauri build --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --no-bundle --config src-tauri/tauri.grok.conf.json -- --locked --features impersonate-boring
scripts.build:windows:portable-launcher:cross: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs xwin build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --target-dir src-tauri/target --manifest-path packaging/windows/launcher/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.test:rust:network: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml local_socket_ -- --ignored
scripts.tls-golden:probe: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin tls-golden-probe --
scripts.test:egress: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml live_upstream_proxy_from_env -- --ignored --nocapture
scripts.test:mitm-smoke: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml live_shownet_mitm_smoke -- --ignored --nocapture
scripts.test:browser-ua: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml browser::tests:: -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
scripts.test:browser-launch: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml browser::tests:: -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
scripts.test:live-capture:impersonate: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features impersonate-boring a_live_capture_session_shows -- --ignored --nocapture
scripts.test:sdk-real: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml export_a_real_session_and_describe -- --ignored --nocapture
scripts.test:font-css: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml a_google_fonts_stylesheet_survives -- --ignored --nocapture
scripts.test:live-capture: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml a_live_capture_session_shows -- --ignored --nocapture
scripts.test:ja4-parity: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features impersonate-boring browser_and_egress_present_one_fingerprint -- --ignored --nocapture
scripts.test:impersonate-mitm: node scripts/rust-stable.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features impersonate-boring mitm_impersonate_presents_chrome -- --ignored --nocapture
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:render && npm run test:browser
